== Publication history, 21 November 2026 ==
Both sides of the retained publisher faces were checked. The printed phrase is 'if you control'. The 2022 frame and image changes retain the printed game text. The earlier Holotable data differs in clause order and wording. A matching early published slip or readable full face is needed to place it in the printed chronology.

The readable full image has since been recovered in the December 2014 Holotable package. Its checksum matches the existing [[File:VB8-L-narshaddaa-pre.gif|Block 8 full-card file]]. The Light Side prints the controller condition. The Dark Side prints the bounty-hunter power bonus and starship reaction. The Dark Side clause has no separate controller condition. The different CDF wording is a transcription witness.<ref>[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-reset image archive], December 2014, member <code>cards/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/narshaddaa.gif</code>.</ref>
